native_event.logical_work: one reaction firing plus clock advance
native_event.physical_requirements: volume, temperature, mixing, molecule supply, sensing/readout, waste/reset and measured energy must be reported
native_event.forbidden_free_advantage: parallel molecular firings, state preparation, and readout are never assigned zero cost

digital_ctmc.event_simulation: O(number_of_reactions) rate work plus declared sampler, precision, and error
digital_ctmc.exactness: exact for rational generator/event-choice algebra; waiting-time/sample realization inherits the declared real-number/randomness instrument

claim_boundary: No physical speed, energy, latency, or precision separation is inferred from logical event counts.
